question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/035f024765d2ae279e06a424eb3386dd97e8c14063f40aa7785d7ce047a96348.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I:- Circles are increasing by +1 in each box. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cafc4ef82e28e05238c1dffe61d38beebc97ad6bf25d1d624ba82331b3977d76.png] 

Step II:- Middle image is rotating by 45⁰ in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b7e5035bdb19cea758e4a3852e5c8a443c8a0e4a82d078ae501f4f8fb404ee3.png] 

So, the series will be:

 [IMAGE: http
s://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53dadefddb49d7f1d252d07bfa6d6cbabf103281b9ca8f9bf0023cb0e4e19d7a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
